findings: Exact Playwright v1.62.1 WebKit adapter maps JavaScript-source error-level protocol console messages into pageerror events, including messages with no stack.

The exact WebKit upstream revision declared by Playwright v1.62.1 emits the retained Cache API wording through its native console logger before returning an exception. Cache completion after a stopped context has such a path.

The retained error name, message and empty stack are consistent with that mapping during the Playground-to-Solo follow navigation; the report has no exception-frame identity or independent DOM error/unhandledrejection witness.
Therefore the observation does not establish an uncaught application exception. The exact initiating cache operation, frame and browser-path attribution remain unproven.
